speaker: Doctor
text: I need to assess your vital signs and level of consciousness. Have you been experiencing fever, excessive sweating, or rapid heart rate recently? Also, did you experience any recent head trauma or new onset seizures?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. Earlier this evening, he exhibited extreme irritability, yelled at his computer, broke it, and then spent several hours at the gym.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your aggressive behavior and gym activity, are you currently experiencing palpitations, sweating, tremors, or feeling unusually hungry or thirsty? Have you recently started taking any new medications, supplements, or recreational drugs, such as amphetamines or cocaine?

REQUEST TEST: Basic Metabolic Panel, TSH, Urine Tox Screen, Pregnancy Test (if applicable).
REQUEST IMAGES: ECG.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Basic Metabolic Panel: NORMAL READINGS; TSH: NORMAL READINGS; Urine Tox Screen: Amphetamines Positive, Cocaine Negative, Opiates Negative, Benzodiazepines Negative, Cannabinoids Negative; Pregnancy Test: NORMAL READINGS; ECG: Tachycardia.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Aggressive behavior and irritability. I also have Yelling, Breaking objects, Prolonged physical activity (several hours at the gym), Rapid speech during exam, Aggressiveness during exam. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Please stay calm; I am ordering an ECG and Basic Metabolic Panel immediately. Based on your history of prolonged intense physical activity, aggressive outbursts, and rapid speech, are you currently experiencing severe anxiety or feeling like you must keep moving despite exhaustion?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history reported by the roommates. Social history: Stress from upcoming final exams. No other social history provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Thyrotoxicosis (Hyperthyroid Storm) precipitated by acute stress and excessive exercise.
